recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is recommended unless the work group opens a new issue to reintroduce or further constrain instant-valued questionnaire answers.
issue_request: FHIR-12434 asked to remove answerInstant from Questionnaire(Response) because the instant datatype is intended for precisely observed/system times rather than human-entered Questionnaire answers. The issue is Published with resolution Persuasive and applied for DSTU2.
initial_application: Git commit bd819cfbf9a33c335e7030ff69591f11f7a57882 explicitly mentions #12434 and removed instant from the then-authoritative Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse spreadsheet sources, including Questionnaire.item.enableWhen.answer[x], Questionnaire.item.initial[x], QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.value[x], and the Questionnaire item-type code list.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread confirms the intended application scope: remove Questionnaire.item.enableWhen.answerInstant, Questionnaire.item.initialInstant, the instant item-type code, and QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.valueInstant. Current source/fhir.ini lists Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse as active resources, and current StructureDefinition/CodeSystem source includes date, dateTime, and time but no instant choice on the relevant answer/value/item-type surfaces. Jira search found no other answerInstant-related issues, and Confluence had no FHIR-12434 references.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The combined branch received an empty no-change audit commit documenting that the current build-scope source remains aligned with FHIR-12434.
